disposition_alternatives_rejected.rejected_because: The mature-world operation contract is not determinate from current evidence. Audit MATRIX W17 = TERMINAL_CONSUMER_CONTRACT_UNDERDEFINED and explicitly asks the question H-D was commissioned to answer. Source selection (W16/H-C), temporal constitution (W15/H-A) and pressure coverage (W08/H-B) are all unresolved, and two of the three feed F8 conditioning directly. Recording 'determinate' would overstate the evidence.

No missing authority FORM is proved. MATRIX C17 (comparator) and W16 (source applicability) both record the form closed while the instance or proof remains. Source selection is the one operation with no adopted authority at all, and W16 describes that as 'precise missing proof, not proved missing form'. Adopting REQUIRES_NEW_AUTHORITY_FORM would assert a conceptual gap the audit declined to assert.

HQD-125 s15 permits reopen only when a responsibility has no lawful representation, no owner, cannot be transported, cannot be validated/refused, cannot be composed at the required grain, AND cannot be satisfied by same-grain succession or bounded implementation. The F8 base model has all four: a lawful representation, a named owner, structural refusal at every gap, and exact-lookup composition at its declared grain. The terminal audit found 'no proved architecture gap'. Reopen is not warranted.

No frozen boundary was found to be violated by any present artifact. The C1 inventory conflict recorded below is a documentary/inventory conflict about which modules are current — a real and HQ-adjudication-worthy finding, but it does not itself exhibit a boundary violation. It is therefore reported as a secondary named finding rather than as the primary disposition, so that the disposition still states H-D's actual semantic conclusion.

MODEL_ALGORITHM_ID is EXACT_CONDITIONAL_LOOKUP__NO_SMOOTHING_INTERPOLATION_OR_EXTRAPOLATION; geometry is pre-materialized on PossibilitySliceEvidence and only SELECTED by exact (source_universe, release, target, retained_conditioner_ids) match, or by a governed strictly-decreasing specificity walkback confined to the same source/release.
load-bearing_semantic_finding.implication: GEOMETRY_TRANSFORMER and DISTRIBUTION_TRANSFORMER are not available at F8 to ANY world input family. A world product can change what F8 returns only by causing an upstream producer to materialize a different evidence slice at a different retained-conditioner grain.
